name: Newport Industries, LLC
old_description: 💡 From Blueprint to Build: How Custom Fabrication is Transforming Modern Architecture
about:
Newport Industries, LLC operates from West Branch, Iowa, as a family‑owned small business. The company does not publish a founding date, but notes that its team brings 100 years of combined experience in metal design, fabrication, and machining. Ownership remains with the founding family, and the business emphasizes hands‑on craftsmanship across every project.

The shop provides design, engineering, fabrication, machining, and artistic metalwork capabilities under one roof. It functions as an original equipment manufacturer, producing three proprietary lines: Industrial Pulley Puller hydraulic gear pullers for maintenance departments, Newport Car Wash stainless‑steel parts and accessories for self‑service car washes, and Newport Living architectural metal products such as TV mounts. Contract manufacturing services are also offered for outside clients.

Primary markets include the self‑service car wash industry, which receives rugged, all‑weather stainless components, and industrial maintenance teams that use the hydraulic pullers to remove frozen gears, bearings, and couplings. Custom fabrication work serves architectural and interior‑design projects, while the OEM lines are sold directly to end users and distributors.

Leadership frames the company’s differentiation around its family‑owned structure and the depth of combined experience, stating that every job—large or small—receives the same focus on quality and expert craftsmanship. The business was built to keep design through final fabrication in house, allowing tighter control over tolerances and finish.
